display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TrustEngine
- Task Success Rate S_i(t)
- Compliance Rate C_i(t)
- Latency Penalty L_i(t)
- Composite Score P_i(t) = 0.6S + 0.3C + 0.1(1-L)
- EMA Temporal Score T_i(t) = 0.7P + 0.3T(prev)
- Sliding Window: 10 Telemetry Events

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AdaptivePolicyEnforcer
- TRUSTED (T >= 0.8): All Operations
- SUSPICIOUS (0.5 <= T < 0.8): Standard Only
- QUARANTINED (T < 0.5): Block All
- REVOKED: Terminal Administrative Lockout

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

(research, analysis, coding, planning, verification)
- Optional HTTP Outbound Delegation (Fallback)
